text_en: Every seventh year you shall grant a remission of debts.
text_cn: 每过七年，应施行豁免。

text_en: And this is the manner of the remission: every creditor shall remit the claim that is held against a neighbor, not exacting it of a neighbor who is a member of the community, because the Lord ’s remission has been proclaimed.
text_cn: 豁免的方式是这样：债主应把借与近人的一切，全部豁免，不应再向近人或兄弟追还，因为已为光荣上主宣布了豁免。

text_en: Of a foreigner you may exact it, but you must remit your claim on whatever any member of your community owes you.
text_cn: 向外邦人可以追还，但你兄弟欠你的应一概豁免。

text_en: There will, however, be no one in need among you, because the Lord is sure to bless you in the land that the Lord your God is giving you as a possession to occupy,
text_cn: 其实，在你中间不会有穷人，因为在你的天主赐给你作为产业的地上，上主必丰厚地祝福你，

text_en: if only you will obey the Lord your God by diligently observing this entire commandment that I command you today.
text_cn: 只要你听从上主你天主的话，谨守遵行我今日吩咐你的这一切诫命。

text_en: When the Lord your God has blessed you, as he promised you, you will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow; you will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.
text_cn: 因为你的天主必照他说的，祝福你：你要借给许多民族，而你却不需要借贷；你要统治许多民族，但他们却不会统治你。

text_en: If there is among you anyone in need, a member of your community in any of your towns within the land that the Lord your God is giving you, do not be hard-hearted or tight-fisted toward your needy neighbor.
text_cn: 如果在上主你的天主赐给你的地内的一座城里，在你中间有了一个穷人，又是你的兄弟，对这穷苦的兄弟，你不可心硬，不可袖手旁观，

text_en: You should rather open your hand, willingly lending enough to meet the need, whatever it may be.
text_cn: 应向他伸手，凡他所需要的尽量借给他。

text_en: Be careful that you do not entertain a mean thought, thinking, “The seventh year, the year of remission, is near, ” and therefore view your needy neighbor with hostility and give nothing; your neighbor might cry to the Lord against you, and you would incur guilt.
text_cn: 你应提防，不要心生恶念说：“第七年的豁免年快到了！”就冷眼对待你穷苦的兄弟，不借给他什么。如果他呼求上主反对你，你应负罪。

text_en: Give liberally and be ungrudging when you do so, for on this account the Lord your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you undertake.
text_cn: 你应尽量供给他；供给他时，不应伤心，因为为了这事，上主你的天主必在你的一切工作，和你着手所作的一切事上祝福你。

text_en: Since there will never cease to be some in need on the earth, I therefore command you, “Open your hand to the poor and needy neighbor in your land. ”
text_cn: 既然在这地上总少不了穷人，为此我吩咐你说：对你地区内困苦贫穷的兄弟，你应大方地伸出援助之手。

text_en: If a member of your community, whether a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and works for you six years, in the seventh year you shall set that person free.
text_cn: 你的兄弟，无论是希伯来男人，或是希伯来女人，若卖身与你，只应服事你六年，在第七年上，你应使他自由。

text_en: And when you send a male slave out from you a free person, you shall not send him out empty-handed.
text_cn: 使他自由时，不可让他空手离去；

text_en: Provide liberally out of your flock, your threshing floor, and your wine press, thus giving to him some of the bounty with which the Lord your God has blessed you.
text_cn: 应由你羊群中，打禾场上，榨酒池内，取一些厚厚地酬报他，照上主你的天主祝福你的，分给他。

text_en: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you; for this reason I lay this command upon you today.
text_cn: 应记得你在埃及地也曾做过奴隶，上主你的天主将你赎回。为此我今日特将这事吩咐你。

text_en: But if he says to you, “I will not go out from you, ” because he loves you and your household, since he is well off with you,
text_cn: 倘若他对你说：“我不愿离开你”，因为他爱你和你的家庭，又喜欢同你在一起，

text_en: then you shall take an awl and thrust it through his earlobe into the door, and he shall be your slave forever. You shall do the same with regard to your female slave.
text_cn: 你就拿锥子在门上把他耳朵刺透，他便永远成了你的奴仆；对你的婢女也该这样做。

text_en: Do not consider it a hardship when you send them out from you free persons, because for six years they have given you services worth the wages of hired laborers; and the Lord your God will bless you in all that you do.
text_cn: 使他自由的时候，你不应感到不满，因为他六年给你服务，应得佣工的双倍工资，并且上主你的天主也必在你所做的事业上祝福你。

text_en: Every firstling male born of your herd and flock you shall consecrate to the Lord your God; you shall not do work with your firstling ox nor shear the firstling of your flock.
text_cn: 你的牛羊中所生的，凡是头胎雄性的，都应祝圣与上主你的天主；你不可使头胎公牛耕作，也不可剪头胎公羊的毛。

text_en: You shall eat it, you together with your household, in the presence of the Lord your God year by year at the place that the Lord will choose.
text_cn: 你和你的家属，年年在上主所选的地方，在上主你的天主面前，吃这些首生的牲畜。

text_en: But if it has any defect—any serious defect, such as lameness or blindness—you shall not sacrifice it to the Lord your God;
text_cn: 但如果这牲畜有残缺、或腿瘸、或瞎眼、或有任何缺点，你不可祭献给上主你的天主，

text_en: within your towns you may eat it, the unclean and the clean alike, as you would a gazelle or deer.
text_cn: 可在家里吃，不洁与洁净的，人都可以吃，如吃羚羊和鹿一样；

text_en: Its blood, however, you must not eat; you shall pour it out on the ground like water.
text_cn: 只不可吃它的血，应将血如水一样泼在地上。
